description: F4 (Paul approved 2026-09-25): Graph says when money is not traced - in the drawer, in the Estimates panel and in the notes - never as $0 or an empty panel. The examples are the contract.
rules: A candidate view (mode activity or estimates) carries candidate_note_title (the tooltip: one "Rebuild with: <command>" line per distinct rebuild command, or ""), transfer_index and transfer_trace; a direct view carries none of the three.

transfer_index lists each cycle F2 names in the workbook's audit manifest (transfer_index_status and transfer_index_notes): {cycle, status, note, command}; note is 'Not traced: the transfer index for <cycle> is <status>' for every status but current, and '' for current. No bundle, a legacy bundle or a bundle that does not match the workbook names nothing: [].

Estimates: with no audit bundle the answer is unavailable and its note is "No estimate bundle for this industry yet; rebuild the workbook." A cycle in scope whose index is not current contributes no estimate; the note says "Not traced: ..." for it, and when every cycle in scope is untraced the view is unavailable with that sentence as its note. An untraced cycle is never shown as $0.

transfer_trace (activity; null when the view was refused before the network was read) is {committees, root_traced, note, command}. committees lists each committee/cycle reached with no saved snapshot whose transfers could not be followed: its workbook has no Transfer Paths sheet (reason 'no saved network, and this workbook has no Transfer Paths sheet') or F2 named its cycle's index stale, missing or unresolved (reason 'no saved network, and the transfer index for <cycle> is <status>'). root_traced is false when the view's one funded committee is untraced in every cycle; then note starts 'Transfers from this committee are not traced: ...' and the drawer stops saying 'and the PACs it funds'. The candidate note carries the same sentences.

The Transfer Paths flag is server.report_quality's transfer_paths ('Transfer Paths' in the sheet names), read from the workbook index (graph_data.has_transfer_paths) because report_quality loads the whole workbook (21 s for Banking, measured 2026-09-25).
